BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: We should ban New Year resolutions. People never keep them anyway so why bother? ASSISTANT:

I don't think we should ban New Year resolutions. Resolutions can be a great way to set goals and motivate yourself to achieve them. It's important to remember that resolutions should be realistic and attainable. It's also important to stay motivated and have a plan to reach your goals.
BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: How much caffeine can I consume per day? ASSISTANT:

It is recommended that adults consume no more than 400 milligrams (mg) of caffeine per day, which is equivalent to about 2.5 cups of coffee. Consuming more than this amount can lead to caffeine-related side effects such as nervousness, restlessness, and insomnia.
